reason: I saw a TikTok about some no-proof settlement and my first thought was how a random site would even know I qualify. I'm not making an account on lawsuitai.org so they can harvest my info — if I actually cared I'd Google the case myself.
objection: How do you even know I qualify? And why should I trust a site that admits its listings aren't verified and then asks me to file somewhere else anyway?
would_change_my_mind: If I could check that one TikTok settlement against an official claims page I already recognize, with no account, and I actually saw my bank or phone company named on the notice.
